texts.arguments: 3. Learned Counsel Mr. Dhande for the applicants appeared through video conferencing and submitted that as far as the custodial interrogation is concerned, which is not required, as the entire stock is seized by the police during the raid. For interrogation purpose, the applicants are ready to abide all the conditions imposed by this Court. He further submitted that the issue regarding the applicability of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code is already pending before the Hon'ble Apex Court. In view of that, the applicants be protected by granting anticipatory bail. 4. Learned APP in both the applications have strongly opposed the applications on the ground that the huge quantity of the contraband articles are seized from the car owned by the present applicants and the cattle shed which is obtained by the present applicants on rent. Their custodial interrogation is required. In view of that, their applications deserve to be rejected.
